frequency_question: How often do targeted industrial financial support schemes intended by central ministry leadership get successfully finalized and operationalized within a 330-day window from inception or prioritization?
membership_rule: Includes major formally announced fiscal incentive, financing, or subsidy frameworks targeting specific manufacturing sectors (e.g., FAME schemes, PLI schemes) led by the relevant central ministry. Excludes minor administrative circulars or unbudgeted proposals.

coverage_note: 5 major central industrial manufacturing subsidy schemes named; captures the primary operational track record of the relevant ministry class.
known_gaps: Does not account for smaller sub-sector notifications that may have faced internal delays, though major flagship schemes show a 100% completion rate once prioritized by the ministry.
skeleton: Ministry-level major capital-intensive industrial incentive frameworks launched since 2018.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 named comparable major industrial support schemes finalized within target operational windows.
validity_reason: Administrative execution capacity and central policy prioritization patterns remain stable across the medium term of the current governance structure.
